name: Unable to Access Account
description: Customers report being unable to access, open, or manage their Spotify accounts through the app.

name: App or Content Won’t Open
description: Customers report that the app or their music library fails to open or load.

name: Login and Sign-In Problems
description: Customers report trouble signing in, staying signed in, or logging into an existing account.

name: Unexpected or Incorrect Charges
description: Customers report being charged unexpectedly, charged the wrong amount, or charged more than once.

name: Billing and Free-Tier Frustrations
description: Customers complain about the app’s costs and restrictions on features available without Premium.

name: Premium Required for Features
description: Customers object to being prompted to get Premium or finding desired listening features restricted to Premium.

name: Premium Is Too Expensive
description: Customers say Premium subscription pricing is too high or has increased.

name: Music and Catalog Issues
description: Customers report missing or unavailable songs, repetitive playback, or unsuitable music suggestions.

name: Lyrics Won’t Load or Appear
description: Customers report that song lyrics are missing or fail to load in the app.

name: Podcast Availability and Features
description: Customers report that podcasts are unavailable, limited by location, or missing expected podcast features.

name: Poor Music Recommendations
description: Customers say recommendations or algorithm-driven playback are repetitive or poorly matched to their preferences.

name: Search Results Are Inaccurate
description: Customers report that search is missing options or returns songs and results that do not match their queries.

name: Downloads Not Working Reliably
description: Customers report trouble downloading or accessing saved music, including when offline.

name: Downloads Disappear or Fail Offline
description: Customers report that downloaded music is deleted or unavailable for offline listening.

name: Ads Dominate the Experience
description: Customers characterize Spotify as overwhelmed by advertising, with some describing it more as an ad service than a music app.

name: General App Dissatisfaction
description: Customers express broad dislike or dissatisfaction without identifying a specific app problem.

name: Negative Update Reactions
description: Customers broadly criticize recent Spotify updates and say the app has worsened after changes.

name: Poor Audio Quality
description: Customers report that music sounds too quiet or has lower sound quality than they expect.

name: App Crashes During Use
description: Customers report that Spotify repeatedly crashes, including while opening or playing music.

name: Playback Problems on Connected Devices
description: Customers report playback stopping, failing, or disconnecting when using car systems or Bluetooth devices.

name: Music Playback Problems
description: Customers report that music playback does not work as expected, including stopping, repeating, or failing to continue in the background.

name: Playback Broken After Updates
description: Customers report that app updates have disrupted playback or made the app hang or fail to open.

name: Support and App Experience Complaints
description: Customers raise broad concerns about customer support and other app experiences, including playlist behavior and the interface.

name: Too Many Interrupting Ads
description: Customers say frequent advertisements interrupt listening and make the app frustrating to use.

name: Playback Controls Missing or Restricted
description: Customers report that shuffle, skip, queue, or other playback controls are missing or limited.

name: General Usability Frustrations
description: Customers complain broadly about the app’s usability, with examples including its interface, ads, and repetitive songs.

name: Playlist and Library Usability
description: Customers report difficulties with playlists or library navigation, including being unable to choose or play songs in order.

name: Update Worsened App Usability
description: Customers say recent updates have made the app slower or harder to use, or removed familiar features.
